stem: A laboratory sample was collected only from the top of one container in a large drying lot. The result meets specification. What is the strongest QA conclusion?
choices: The full lot is proven compliant
The result describes the tested sample, but lot-level inference is weak unless the sampling plan represented meaningful lot variation
rationale: A precise laboratory result cannot repair an unrepresentative sampling design. Lot definition and representative sampling determine what the result can support.
